title: gymnadenia × geigelsteiniana
intro: Gymnadenia × geigelsteiniana, commonly known as the Geigelstein's Orchid, is a hybrid orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and oxidative stress due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia × geigelsteiniana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, contribute to its therapeutic effects, although further research is needed to fully understand its properties and potential applications.
